description: Doctor Carlos Messina Staircase, Vitória, Espírito Santo, Brazil, 1926. Location: a broad staircase that connects Francisco Araújo and General Osorio avenues. "Formerly the Ladeira do Egito, the staircase is part of an eclectic set of staircases that includes Barbara Lindenberg, São Diogo, Dionysus Rosendo, Maria Ortiz staircases.
